Senses.Explanation: The leap directly into the Tathagata’s ground compresses gradual gates into immediate entry, while several sermons test whether their hearers can actually make that leap. Yuanwu supplies the inherited verse and a retained direct answer with the line; later instructions contrast direct entry with the expedients discussed before it.
